## Summary

Describe the user-visible or evidence-boundary change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full affected Python/frontend gates pass.
- [ ] Generated reports/dashboard data come from executable code and `data:check` passes.
- [ ] No raw data, model artifact, credential, `.env`, cache, or generated noise is included.
- [ ] No unsupported production, security, compliance, calibration, fairness, or performance claim is introduced.
- [ ] Historical test evidence was not reused for tuning.
- [ ] Documentation/control files and known limitations are updated where relevant.

## Risk and rollback

State failure modes, compatibility impact, and the smallest safe rollback.
